description: Read the RECIPE a sound was made from (the editable source), with its name, url, duration, whether it loops and the sound it was edited from. The account's own sounds, or anyone's public one; an uploaded file has no recipe. To change a sound, r3_sound_update makes a new version of it.

audioId.description: The sound's id (r3_sound_create or r3_audio_list answer it).

name: r3_sound_read

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Read a sound's recipe
